name: cache-bell
description: Cache & context manager for Claude Code. Once the context passes a size you choose, Claude compacts after a finished piece of work, and you get time to cancel. While you're away, the plugin keeps the prompt cache warm or compacts before it expires.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn off to pause the plugin without uninstalling it; off wins over any profile. Cache Bell, made by the Holler Bell team. hollerbell.com

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: off, watch or bellcompact. off: nothing. watch: the countdown and the size only; nothing is sent and Claude is told nothing. bellcompact: Claude is told how full the context is and compacts on its own from compactLevelK on; an idle session's cache is renewed and, with idleCompact, compacted before it expires. enabled off wins over any profile. Default: bellcompact.

compactLevelK.title: Compact from (thousand tokens)
compactLevelK.description: bellcompact: from this size of the context on, Claude is asked, in a line you do not see, to compact at the next good point. 0 = never; the cache is still renewed. Claude Code's own auto-compact stays as the last resort at the edge of the window. Default: 200.

compactContextNotices.title: Tell Claude how full the context is
compactContextNotices.description: From half of the context window on, Claude is told after a tool result how full the context is: numbers only, at each further 5 % of the window and at 85, 90 and 95 %. You do not see it.

compactOnRequest.title: Compaction asked for by Claude
compactOnRequest.description: confirm, wait, auto or off: what happens when Claude itself asks for a compaction. confirm: you are asked and it compacts when the countdown ends without your answer. wait: you are asked and nothing happens unless you say Compact. auto: it compacts right after the turn. off: Claude cannot ask. Default: confirm.

compactCountdown.title: Compaction countdown (seconds)
compactCountdown.description: How long you have to cancel a compaction Claude asked for, 5 to 3600 seconds. Claude may name a time of its own, 10 to 600 seconds. Default: 30.

compactNotesInRow.title: Compactions in a row followed by a note
compactNotesInRow.description: When Claude asks for a compaction, it may leave itself a note. The note is sent back as a prompt once the compaction is done, so the session carries on by itself. This sets how many compactions in a row may be followed by such a note before you have to write a message. A message you send from Slack counts too, and so does one from another Claude session. Every note starts a new turn, and those turns count against the limits of your plan, or are billed to your API key. 0 = no limit: the session can keep going without you for as long as Claude keeps leaving notes. Default: 5.

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: Instructions for the summary, as after /compact. {time} and {idle} are filled in. Empty = a plain compaction. Default: empty.

idleMinContextK.title: Idle: minimum context (thousand tokens)
idleMinContextK.description: Below this the plugin does nothing about the cache of an idle session: a small context is left to expire. A compaction Claude asks for is not affected. Default: 80.

idleAsk.title: Idle: ask
idleAsk.description: first, every or never: when you are asked before the plugin renews or compacts an idle session's cache. first: the first time in an idle period. every: every time. never: not at all. Default: first.

idleAskAheadMinutes.title: Idle: ask ahead (minutes)
idleAskAheadMinutes.description: How long before the time to act the question appears. 0 = automatic: 15 minutes on an hour-long cache, 30 seconds on a five-minute one. Default: 0 (automatic).

idleRenewals.title: Idle: renewals
idleRenewals.description: How many times an idle session's cache is renewed, 0 to 3. Each renewal is a silent side request on your plan that reads the whole context; one that gets no answer is tried once more within the three. Default: 2.

idleRenewPrompt.title: Idle: renewal prompt
idleRenewPrompt.description: The prompt of a renewal. Default: "This request only keeps the prompt cache warm. Answer with the single word: ok"
idleRenewPrompt.default: This request only keeps the prompt cache warm. Answer with the single word: ok

idleCompact.title: Idle: compact
idleCompact.description: auto, on or off: whether an idle session is compacted once the renewals are used up, before the cache expires. auto: only while the cache lives an hour; on five minutes you are mostly back before it would pay off. on: always. off: never; the cache expires. Default: auto.

idleAnnounce.title: Idle: announce the compaction
idleAnnounce.description: Tell the session that a compaction is coming, in a turn of its own, right before it.

idleAnnouncePrompt.title: Idle: announcement
idleAnnouncePrompt.description: What the session is told before a compaction. Empty = nothing is said. Default: "This conversation will be compacted right after this turn. Nothing is needed from you: a one-line reply is enough."
idleAnnouncePrompt.default: This conversation will be compacted right after this turn. Nothing is needed from you: a one-line reply is enough.

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto, settings, 5m or 1h. auto: the lifetime the API granted, read from the usage figures at the end of the session's transcript (nothing of what was said). settings: the transcript is never read; the lifetime is only what the settings ask for, so nothing is renewed or compacted on its own. 5m or 1h: set by hand; the transcript still gives the time of the last request. Default: auto.

cacheRequestHour.title: Ask for the hour-long cache
cacheRequestHour.description: ask, on or off. ask: a notice asks what you do after a reply; only "come back within the hour" (or /bell hour on) turns the hour on. on: always. With the hour on, the plugin sets CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=1h for this Claude Code process, at a moment the cache is cold anyway; shell commands of the main conversation do not get it while no subagent runs; shell commands of subagents and other processes Claude Code starts do, and a claude -p gives it back as it starts. Off, it goes with the next request; enabled off or the off profile never ask for it and take back the plugin's own value; disabled or uninstalled in Claude Code, it stays until Claude Code ends. A TTL you set yourself, or cacheTtl = 5m, stops it. The hour-long cache costs more to write; it pays off when you come back after pauses. Default: ask.

display.title: Display
display.description: band, status, both or off: where the countdown shows. band: above the prompt. status: in the status line. both: in both. off: nowhere. A question is always shown above the prompt. Default: status.

displayBelowMinutes.title: Show the countdown below (minutes)
displayBelowMinutes.description: The countdown of a warm cache appears once this many minutes or fewer are left. 0 = always. A cold cache, a question and the plugin at work are always shown. Default: 15.

mode.title: Mode (0.2.x, replaced by profile)
mode.description: Kept so that a mode set before 0.3.4 still counts: notify is the watch profile, keep is bellcompact with compactLevelK 0, idleCompact off, idleAsk never and 3 renewals, prepare-compact is bellcompact, compact-only is bellcompact with idleCompact on and idleAsk never, without renewals or announcement. Set profile instead and leave this empty. (notify, keep, prepare-compact, compact-only or custom)

guarded.title: Claude Code guards this plugin's classic hooks
guarded.description: Set by a runner that starts Claude Code where Claude Code seats its guard ahead of the plugins (a Team or Enterprise account, managed settings). On: the plugin registers none of the hooks the guard keeps, so Claude Code does not report them skipped. Leave it off otherwise.
